name: Junior volunteer program at Del Sol Medical Center
what_you_do: Volunteer at the hospital in one of several positions. The program page does not list the tasks.
who_can_apply: Ages 14 to 18, in good standing at school.
duration: Not stated on the program page
deadline_text: Junior volunteer applications are accepted from March 15 through May 1 each year. Expect it to reopen around March 15, 2027.
how_to_apply: Fill out the printable volunteer application on the program page. If accepted, pass a background check, drug screening and TB skin test, and attend orientation. Call (915) 263-5243.
notes: The page gives the March 15 to May 1 window as a yearly pattern, not as dates for 2027. Check the page in March.
